scope: Regional slack diagnosis of the frozen bounds; no new upper/lower bound or unrestricted optimizer claim

leaf_reconciliation.method: Streamed every selected leaf and independently re-summed all four integer columns by label; exact rational group/global comparison.

identity: U-R = E + screening(0) + origin_IR(0) + weighted_IC + sum_rows(capacity+virtual)
cycle_accounting: Existing cycles are directly included in regional C/V and U. Signed cycle diagnostics are not added again; only their separate nonnegative weighted IC slack enters this identity.

scalar_contraction.interpretation: Necessary interval consequences of one exact scalar sum identity. Bounds on different rows share one budget and need not be simultaneously attainable.

semantic_areas.interpretation: Unordered bidder-report pairs; mixed labels include both bidder orders. L is contained in Q. Boundaries have zero volume.

exact_semantic_projection.interpretation: Alternative six-region projection of the same seven-row structural ledger and the same E. Do not add this table to the numerical-cell table.
exact_semantic_projection.region_definition: True unordered B/E/Q report pairs on the full continuous report space, with a measurable null-boundary assignment.

numerical_mass_constraints.block_definition: For every listed numerical block m and allowed true semantic R: e[m,R]>=0, sum_R e[m,R]=e[m] within its one block mass interval; forbidden coordinates vanish.
component_and_global_constraints: For each source block m, nonnegative e[m,k] exists only for k in its incidence set; sum_k e[m,k] lies in that one block mass interval.
For each component, all its block masses share the one certified component total interval. A crossing block upper is not a separate budget for every incident region.
D_omitted + D_own_Jensen lies in the frozen own_cell_and_omission_loss interval.
D_omitted + D_own_Jensen + D_opponent_Jensen lies in the frozen D_error interval.
B_majorant + D_omitted + D_own_Jensen + D_opponent_Jensen equals E in its frozen interval.
A row upper is a one-row projection of shared constraints; the displayed row upper endpoints need not be simultaneously attainable.

exact_semantic_projection.conformity: The true common measure overlay is defined; per-primary-leaf numerical error intersections are not materialized. D semantic projections use exact nonnegative own-report pushforwards only because the opposite low square lies wholly in Q.
exact_semantic_projection.interval_scope: Conservative coordinate projections and necessary scalar-identity contractions. Upper endpoints share budgets; neither simultaneous attainability nor a sharp full incidence LP projection is claimed.
exact_semantic_projection.low_square_scope: C,V,screening,origin_IR,IC vanish when either report is in the low square. Numerical error E is not asserted to vanish there.

subset_coverage.denominator: Complete frozen U-R, including numerical E
subset_coverage.mechanism_definition: C+V+exact weighted IC; screening and origin IR are zero; E is excluded
subset_coverage.method: Each selected mass and its complement retain the C/V/E component-sum intervals as well as the global scalar identity; marginal row upper bounds are not added.
subset_coverage.minimality_scope: Smallest cardinality certified by these particular interval calculations among the 63 nonempty subsets of the chosen six coarse regions. A smaller actual covering subset is not excluded; this is not a globally minimal mechanism repair set.

aggregation_rule: Sum the seven coarse rows OR all their regime children, never both. All menu_interface groups occur once in the mixed-semantic pool.
transition_diagnostic_scope: Overlaps coarse rows and drilldowns; resolution diagnostic only, never an additional contribution.
ranking_scope: Display order is not a theorem of full ordering. A strict comparison is certified only where one lower endpoint exceeds the other upper endpoint; mixed-semantic mass is kept in its single separate row.
